levels.surface: عبد الله ابن عبيد الله الهاشمي

notes: «[عن أبيه]» is a bracketed insertion in the text; it is read as a link (relation), per the bracket convention.
The Imam after «عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام» is written inside the chain, so he stays a narrator; his words «كان لرسول الله ... خاتمان» are the saying.
